==Required for completing==
Completion of Desert Treasure I is required for the following:
*[[Recipe for Disaster]] – [[Recipe for Disaster/Defeating the Culinaromancer|Defeating the Culinaromancer]]
*[[Curse of the Empty Lord]] (miniquest) -- only partial completion of Desert Treasure I required.
*[[Hopespear's Will]] (miniquest)
*[[The Frozen Door]] (miniquest)
*Hard tiers of the [[Desert Diary]], [[Varrock Diary]], and [[Morytania Diary]]
*Elite tiers of the [[Ardougne Diary|Ardougne]], [[Wilderness Diary|Wilderness]], [[Lumbridge & Draynor Diary|Lumbridge]], and [[Desert Diary]]
*[[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]]
